dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible elliptical and circular 'O' shaped structures exhibit a sharp pixel intensity transition at the outer perimeter from the dark grey background to high-intensity white. The internal gradient shows a gradual decrease in intensity towards a mid-tone grey center, particularly prominent in the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: The anterior-dorsal region displays a high density of small, solid, high-intensity white clusters with no internal gradients. The density of these solid blobs decreases moving towards the posterior, where larger, hollow annuli become the dominant feature.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A central group of three prominent macro-annuli forms an obtuse scalene triangle in the mid-lateral field. The distance between the centroids of the two largest annuli is approximately double the diameter of the larger structure, with a secondary cluster of smaller blobs forming a linear chain along the lower ventral-lateral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: An elongated, irregular, high-contrast white streak with a jagged morphology is located at the posterior boundary where the torso meets the hind flipper.
